cover.kicker: 封面故事 · GitHub 项目
cover.title:
Chrome 官方的 agent 指南
两周从日增个位数冲到 4,142
cover.dek: modern-web-guidance 14 天前每天只涨 1 到 15 颗星,11-14 到峰值,今天仍有 +2,408。HN 上 448 分、146 条评论,是今天少有的真实讨论。
cover.title_en:
Chrome's official agent guide
went from single digits to 4,142 a day
cover.dek_en: Two weeks ago modern-web-guidance gained 1 to 15 stars a day. It peaked on 11-14 and still added +2,408 today. Its Show HN thread drew 448 points and 146 comments, real discussion on a day short of it.

stickers.title: 管住 agent
stickers.text: 评测、审查、人工审批类项目同时起量,LoopForge 日增 +972,open-code-review +951。
stickers.text_en: Evaluation, review and approval tools are rising together: LoopForge +972 a day, open-code-review +951.

stickers.title: 论文角
stickers.text: 记忆压缩有了对照实验:答案是数值时压缩占优,需要原话时反而落后。
stickers.text_en: A memory study on LoCoMo finds compression wins for numeric answers and loses when the exact wording matters.

stickers.title: 曝光落差
stickers.text: rea 的 YouTube 教程曝光约 868,000 次,真实讨论却几乎没有。
stickers.text_en: The rea tutorials pulled roughly 868,000 YouTube views, yet there's almost no real discussion behind them.
